name: Arcada University of Applied Sciences
summary: Swedish-speaking applied-sciences university in Helsinki; three English bachelor's in IT, business and sustainable engineering, won on IB grades.

ib.text: Certificate-based selection on the UAS IB scoring table: at least 60 points to be considered. An IB taught in English proves your English.

dates.label: Passport or EU/EEA ID copy due, 15:00
Final IB grades due through IBIS, 15:00

programmes.name: Information Technology
programmes.about: Software development for web, mobile and cloud, with a specialisation in Intelligent Robotics or in Data Processing and Analytics, plus internships and research projects with industry.
programmes.ib: Maths at grade 2 in AA (SL or HL) or AI HL, or grade 4 in AI SL (Arcada's A/C rule on the UAS IB table); 12 places, 9 for matriculation/IB applicants.

needs.note: AI SL counts as basic maths and needs grade 4 (UAS IB table: 2 = A, 4 = C).

programmes.selectionNote: January: ranked on IB grades with the UAS scoring table, 60 points minimum, 9 places. The separate application adds 28 places for SAT, ACT or OMPT holders.

programmes.name: International Business
programmes.about: Sustainable business solutions built with digital tools and industry systems, specialising in Strategic Marketing, Logistics and Trade, or Accounting, with work placements in Finland or abroad.
programmes.selectionNote: January: ranked on IB grades with the UAS scoring table, 60 points minimum, 20 places. The separate application adds 55 places for SAT, ACT or OMPT holders.

programmes.name: Mechanical and Sustainable Engineering
programmes.about: Engineering, sustainability and digitalisation combined for carbon-neutral solutions: materials characterisation, product design and manufacturing technology, in small groups.
programmes.ib: Maths at grade 2 in AA (SL or HL) or AI HL, or grade 4 in AI SL (Arcada's A/C rule on the UAS IB table); 8 places, 6 for matriculation/IB applicants.

needs.note: AI SL counts as basic maths and needs grade 4 (UAS IB table: 2 = A, 4 = C).

programmes.selectionNote: January: ranked on IB grades with the UAS scoring table, 60 points minimum, 6 places. The separate application adds 17 places for SAT, ACT or OMPT holders.

notes: In the January joint application only 35 places (IT 9, International Business 20, Engineering 6) go to matriculation-type diplomas such as the IB.
If your IB grades miss the thresholds, a separate application (30 October 2026 to 19 April 2027) accepts SAT, ACT or the OMPT maths test instead, with 100 more places; it may close early once full.
Arcada's fourth English programme, Nursing TopUp, is only for nurses already qualified outside the EU/EEA.
